summary.measurement: Fresh-process canonical C# and scalar Rust graph timing on identical frozen inputs. Warmup/measured counts mean complete corpus sweeps. Allocation instrumentation is isolated in separate Rust processes; no speed target or SIMD claim.

raw_runs.instrumentation: Uninstrumented graph latency; current-thread managed allocation count is sampled outside the timed graph calls. Native allocation is not measured.
raw_runs.measurement: Complete manifest-order corpus sweeps. Graph call includes session input binding and borrowed output; tracing, hashing, file I/O and output copying are excluded. Corpus samples sum individual graph times; sweep wall samples include timestamp/bookkeeping overhead. First calls share prepared sessions; only the first call is process-cold.
raw_runs.process_memory_semantics: Parent sampled process high-water resident memory; includes bundle validation, model loading, runtime, inputs and bookkeeping. This is not activation memory or a managed/native heap peak.
